title: Retrospective Advice: jobb lett volna, ha... ('it would have been better if')

sections.title: Evaluating Better Past Choices
sections.content: To evaluate choices retrospectively: *Jobb lett volna, ha azonnal szólunk.* ('It would have been better if we had said something immediately.'). *Érdemes lett volna megfontolni...* ('It would have been worth considering...').

items.spanish: Jobb lett volna, ha megbeszéljük a részleteket a szerződéskötés előtt.
items.english: It would have been better if we had discussed the details before signing the contract.

items.spanish: Érdemes lett volna kikérni egy második véleményt is.
items.english: It would have been worthwhile to ask for a second opinion as well.
